name: Soft Editorial
avoid_for: Decks that need visual heat or punch — the warm-paper palette and Cormorant serif are intentionally quiet
weak_cases: Dense interiors still need space between cards; decorative pastel cannot silently become status color.
visual_signature: Cream paper, translucent rounded cards, pastel fills and gentle serif italic emphasis.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Italic serif emphasis and drop caps are not universally portable; substitute deliberate script-aware treatments.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
